about: Declarative specs for the paper's diagrams. Every `src` must occur verbatim in the file its section names (build.mjs checks it): each cell carries a quote that must still occur in its source. A related-work cell marked "unshaded" states a design claim, not a v0 result, and is drawn without the holds shading.

boxes.title: Admission
boxes.body: `tide-admit` runs inside a pinned rustc and checks the subset, authority and `Pure`. A rejected crate gets no artifact.

boxes.title: RUN-3 sandbox
boxes.body: The test runs as a child process under Landlock and seccomp. The driver prints the level first: `full`, or `partial, not enforced`.

boxes.title: Simulator
boxes.body: Under `Root::sim(seed)` the seed decides the schedule, and virtual time advances only when every task is blocked.

boxes.title: Replay
boxes.body: The manifest records the seed, source hashes, build identity and inputs. Replay refuses a mismatched identity.

steps.title: Frozen candidate
steps.body: The change, frozen for review; every reviewer is read-only.
steps.src: each reviewer read-only on a frozen candidate

steps.title: Codex pass
steps.body: `gpt-6.1-sol`, effort high. The author fixes or rebuts each finding; the supervisor re-checks until it reports the tree clean.
steps.src: the supervisor re-checks them until it reports the tree clean

steps.title: Opus review
steps.body: On the Codex-clean tree. The author fixes or rebuts; the reviewer that found each finding re-checks only its fix.
steps.src: the reviewer that found each finding re-checks only its fix or rebuttal

steps.title: Lands on main
steps.body: The human maintainer remains final merge authority.
